_about: F35: one story moment per rank-up (design/story.md "Story moments, rank by rank"), played at the console between shifts, once per device (Settings → Replay lessons plays them again). Each line: voice mon = Management types it on the monitor · spk = the Veteran's talking bubble over the monitor (Management can cut in: a mon line in the middle of his). words = a key in content/text/en.json story.lines. look = a console part to outline while the moment plays (optional; a part that isn't on the console yet is just left out). F40 (ranks 10–30) — a line can also have: monitor = what the monitor does while the line is up ('flicker' = it heard that · 'alarm' = it flashes red, the capture at 30) · crackle = the Veteran's bubble squelches more often while it waits (looks.crackleEvery) · cut = the line is cut off: once it has typed out, the moment moves on by itself after looks.cutSeconds (no tap). Looks on the tank (eyes at 10/11/24, a whisper at 15/27, the pressure line at 18, a multi-colour piece at 20, cracks at 22) wait for those pieces (F62 eyes…) — the words play now. F66 — sign = the line puts a name box on the monitor (PLEASE SIGN HERE at rank 0): Sign or Skip moves on instead of Got it (Console.tsx; words en.json story.sign). F63 (ranks 31–39) — voice head = the goop in your head: the whisper bubble (plain outline, no speech wave) over the monitor area, tap to move on; him = it's the Veteran talking from inside the white goop (35, 37 — only who's named for screen readers changes). {name} in a line's words = your name (or Operator #4471). Looks on the tank at 32–38 (the white goop drifting to a crack, the pressure line wobbling, eyes blinking together, him looking up / glowing, the laser meter dimming) have no console part to outline yet — the words play now; rank 31's 'every eye turns to it' happens in the shift (eyes turn to him as he drops in, whiteGoop.json eyesTurnSec). F45 (ranks 40–49) — voice goop = the goop through the speaker (41, 43, 48): the Veteran's bubble place over the monitor, in the goop's look (the head bubble's colours, not his light ones; looks.goopOutline = its outline: 'wave' = the speaker's speech wave, 'plain' = the in-your-head bubble), named the goop for screen readers · monitor 'glitch' = for a beat the screen shows something that isn't a face (45, Management slipping; looks.glitch*) · a cut Management line (45's 'HUMAN RESOURCE.') has no Got it: once typed it moves on by itself after looks.cutSeconds — the correction types next · rattle = the hatch under the console rattles as the line comes up (46, 47 — look 'hatch' outlines it; it opens in F64; looks.rattle*). Looks on the tank: 40's mouths (eyes.json, rank 40+), 42's glowing pressure line and 41's grille buzzing have no part to show yet — the words play; 48's 'every mouth opens at once' happens in the next shift (eyes.json chorus*). F64 (rank 50): Management's last line — FINAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW, with the red alarm — then the final shift, where the Veteran drops in with his own lines (en.json finalShift.vet, finalShift.json intro).
_looks: F40: the numbers of the story looks. flickerSeconds = how long the monitor flickers · alarmSeconds = one red flash of the alarm (it flashes while the line is up) · alarmColour = the red · alarmWords = the words' colour on the alarm (Muzzy 2026-10-24: white) · crackleEvery = seconds between the bubble's squelches on a crackle line (talk.json squelchEvery is the usual) · cutSeconds = how long a cut line stays once typed out before the next line takes over. F45: goopOutline = the goop-through-the-speaker bubble's outline ('wave' or 'plain') · glitchAfterSeconds = how long after the line comes up the monitor glitches · glitchSeconds = how long the not-a-face shows (a beat) · glitchColour = its colour · rattleSeconds = one rattle of the hatch · rattleShake = how far it shakes (share of its own width) · rattleTimes = how many times it rattles.
_catchUp: Most moments played in one visit to the console (the newest ones), e.g. after two rank-ups in one shift or on a device that skipped some.
_newCareer: F65 the new career (after the ending, a career done on this device): these moments play instead of the usual ones of the same rank. Rank 0: the monitor slips — 'WELCOME BA—' (cut off: it moves on by itself) — then the usual welcome, your title (Former Employee), and the sign-in again, so the goop learns the name (story.md 'Rank titles').
_whispers: In-shift whispers (design/story.md: 3 '…cold…' — one you'll doubt, once per device · then one whisper a shift, the goop getting better at talking: stages = from a rank on, the words it says (8+ feelings · 15+ single words · 24+ names; a stage replaces the one before). A plain bubble pointing into the tank; no tap, it goes by itself. Seconds are rules time (pauses stop them). noVoicesFrom = from this rank Management answers each whisper ('THERE ARE NO VOICES IN THE TANK…', en.json story.lines.noVoices) noVoicesDelaySeconds after the whisper goes, for noVoicesSeconds, where the in-shift messages show. Words: en.json story.whispers.
_events: F74: moments for something that happened, not a rank — each plays once per device (Settings → Replay lessons plays it again), after any rank moment that's due, with the same line options. rankLock = the first time the rank lock holds at the console (the meter full, no crack quota met this rank): Management explains it, the meter outlined (look 'meter'). Seen as 'story:rankLock'.
